rule: Wallets of apps, relayers and fee accounts that touch the holders of many unrelated tokens. The transfer_graph lane (scripts/transfer_graph.py) never links holders through them and never counts them as a burst sender. Additions only, and only by a ticket: each entry needs its address, a reason and its source. Removing an entry needs a ticket too.
